mentions.name: Klar
mentions.description: A local-first AI spam filter for Apple Mail on macOS. It uses a model that classifies incoming messages as ham, spam, or marketing, running locally on the user's machine; it is packaged for Apple Mail but could be used in other places.
mentions.source_excerpt: I _just_ published https://klar.im/ a local-first AI spam filter for Apple Mail on mac.
mentions.author: nha1
